bugs.headline: Enhancement Request: VOS Applications to Support Custom Destination Ports for Remote Syslog
bugs.description: Symptom: Today, VOS based applications like CUCM,CUC,IM&P allow an admin to configure remote syslog destination IP. However, the port number can either be 514, or 601, or 6514 where remote syslog servers would be listening. This is an enhancement request to allow an admin to define the destination port for remote syslog traffic. This feature is available in many of our products and applications such as CMS,VCS/Expressway,CIMC,IOS,etc. and can be used to segregate the traffic and map unique ports to each application for ease of management on the 3rd party syslog server. For VOS, remote syslog protocol selection is supported; however, the destination ports are fixed to the supported protocol/port combinations please check below: UDP: port 514 (default) TCP: port 601 TLS: port 6514 The CLI command below changes the protocol only; it does not provide an option to define a custom destination port: utils remotesyslog set protocol udp utils remotesyslog set protocol tcp utils remotesyslog set protocol tls Note: I tested these commands on CUCM, CUIC, Finesse, VVB version 15.0(1) Conditions: This is applicable when admin wants to change the default destination port to a custom port for remote syslog. Workaround: None Further Problem Description: NA

bugs.headline: A consecutive UCM upgrade without switch-version requires system reboot before starting new upgrade
bugs.description: Symptom: A consecutive UCM upgrade without switch-version requires system reboot before starting new upgrade Conditions: CUCM Version: Seen in 12.5(1), 14.0(1) and 15.0(1) Steps: 1) First upgrade : 12.5.1.12900-9 to 12.5.1.12900-112. (Installation Passed) 2) No switch-version 3) Second Upgrade: 12.5.1.12900-112 to 12.5.1.12900-113. (Installation failed) This is the issue where cucm cluster went through some upgrade with out switch version, then if you try one more upgrade for the whole cluster starting from publisher, and it failed with the following error: 01/22/2020 09:35:16 platform_post_install|File:/etc/opt/cisco/install/setup/setup_java_api.sh:45, Function: setup_java_api(), No source API jar files found| 01/22/2020 09:35:16 upgrade_manager.sh|File:/common/download/12.5.1.12900-113/upgrade_manager.sh:2712, Function: main(), Platform upgrade failed| Workaround: Restart (utils system switch-version) the nodes that failed/passed the Upgrade and didn't switch-version before starting a new upgrade. bugs.headline: CAXL client enhancement to randomize login post failover
bugs.description: Symptom: When connectivity to home node fails all clients will try to reconnect to a different node at the same time. Conditions: Connectivity to home node fails Workaround: No workarounds Further Problem Description: If all clients try to connect to a different node at the same time load on that server will suddenly increase
